title: CERTAIN-COAST: certified early warning for coastal aquifers and infrastructure

creators.name: Zeqiraj, Dulian
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Geology and Mining, Polytechnic University of Tirana

description: Open-source MATLAB code (also runs in GNU Octave) of the CERTAIN-COAST project, version 0.1.0: alarms whose miss rate is stated in advance and checked in operation; warnings for chloride crossings between laboratory samples; a learnable inland boundary for the flow equation; recharge from groundwater heads; a steady variable-density flow and salt model of a coastal section (Henry benchmark); and goal-oriented design of monitoring and recharge wells from two adjoint solves. A fast machine-learned copy of the model and the decision tools follow in later versions.
